title: What access remains after a removal
question: Removing a user from a project, a group or a company: which of their access sources should go? Should removal from one company also revoke their access in other companies' projects?
context: Today removing a user from a project deletes direct and group grants there but leaves group membership, so a later group update can grant access again (USER-REQ-043). Removing a user from a company revokes all their assignments, including in other companies (USER-REQ-044). Removing super-admin status must keep project-admin access (USER-REQ-040).
